results.title: Madame Lola
results.overview: A film composed of archival material and excerpts from an interview conducted in 1999 for the unfinished film “The True Story of Madame L.” After a decade out of the public eye, a group of film students manages to interview the woman who was once the most famous psychic on the Spanish scene. The political fortune teller, the snake charmer, the master of ceremonies, the ultimate charlatan: Madame Lola.

results.title: Thoughts & Prayers
results.overview: In a dystopic America, children are taught how to prepare for school shootings through elaborate drills. Yet what are intended as self-defense mechanisms are themselves deeply traumatic for students, parents, educators, and entire communities.

results.title: End Less
results.overview: Improvised over the course of a single night in Paris, this short film follows Fanny and Alexis, who meet by chance on a warm August evening. Fanny doesn’t believe in second dates, always less magical than the first spark. To prove her wrong, Alexis proposes an unusual pact: to meet every week as if it were their very first time.

results.title: Girl in the Attic
results.overview: Kelsey honors her late mother by training for a marathon and sharing her journey online. Her posts attract Billy, a grocery worker caring for his disabled mother, Debbie. Obsessed, Billy kidnaps Kelsey and hides her in their attic, controlling her for years. When Debbie discovers the truth, she and Kelsey must fight for survival.

results.title: The Sixth Robber
results.overview: A suspect in a massive armored car heist, who initially evades arrest, is ultimately caught when his hidden criminal intent blossoms and is discovered by vigilant police.

results.title: Angel Hair
results.overview: Living unhoused near a flea market, two kids spend their days lifting small items from the pockets of strangers-a wallet, a watch, a comb-for fun and for their survival, until the rules catch up with them.

results.title: ČERNÁK
results.overview: Miki Černák, a boy from Telgárt, became a respected boss of a mafia group. But it is not enough for Černák. He wants to dominate all of Slovakia. Become the boss of all bosses. However, the way to the top is lined with traitors and corpses. And Černák underestimated the strongest mafia that ever ruled Slovakia - politicians and their secret service.

results.title: Dog of God
results.overview: In a 17th century Swedish Livonian village, constant rain and drunkenness prevail. When a stolen relic sparks witchcraft accusations, an 80-year-old self-proclaimed werewolf named the Dog of God arrives with a mysterious gift: The Devil’s Balls.

results.title: Amityville Chupacabra
results.overview: When a team of cryptozoologists captures a legendary beast, they unleash an unstoppable nightmare inside a secret facility. Stalked and torn apart one by one, survival becomes impossible as the Amityville Chupacabra claims its prey. A creature feature of blood, legend, and fear—this is Amityville like you’ve never seen before.

results.title: San Cornelio
results.overview: On the day of Cornelio's funeral, Carmela is very sad.

results.title: The Protector
results.overview: With the region's last source of freshwater buried under a Native American reservation and evil forces angling for control, a convict fighting for her freedom becomes the unlikely protector of a young boy who may have the power to save it

results.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
results.overview: Tafiti, a young meerkat, initially rejects friendship with Bristles, a bush pig. When his grandpa is bitten by a snake, Tafiti sets off to find the flower for the cure. Bristles wants to prove that adventures are always better with friends.

results.title: Unveiling Shadow
results.overview: When a young woman with a history of hyperfixation experiences a series of bizarre occurrences, she begins to suspect she is dealing with more than just an ordinary stalker.

results.title: Apocalypse in the Tropics
results.overview: Through deep examination, this documentary from Oscar nominee Petra Costa explores the profound impact of evangelism on Brazil's political landscape.

results.title: So refreshing
results.overview: A quirky Tinder match between a queer Romanian and a London baker leads to a culture-clashing ride through awkward truths, identity, and unexpected intimacy.

results.title: The Organist
results.overview: At his father’s funeral, a young man wrestles with his impulses with the arrival of a last minute replacement organist.

results.title: Serenity
results.overview: A funeral home employee must put her own personal struggles aside to help a grieving woman who just lost her daughter.

results.title: Husky Christmas
results.overview: Burned-out exec Olivia and reclusive writer Theo meet when their dogs' leashes tangle, sparking a charming, unexpected romance-for both pairs.

results.title: Dhoom Dhaam
results.overview: On their wedding night, an oddball couple is thrust into a chaotic chase, dodging goons and cops in a frenzied hunt for the mysterious "Charlie."

results.title: Chica Rica
results.overview: Aspiring singer Franco de la Rosa sneaks into the Viña del Mar International Song Festival with the help of his unscrupulous manager and becomes an overnight sensation with his song "Chica Rica".
